items.title: Hypolite Charles Interview, 1963-04-13
items.q: I said, look me, I'm going in there and play my horn... I'm the one who took his place playing those... Pierrot was the only one who played the afternoon tea.

ctx.x: He made some records with Steve and Steve could play. He may not be unable to read, but Steve could play that piano, Steve Lewis.
Did he play that piano? That was Pierrot's piano player. You have to hit off. Oh, God. He's still living?
Who's Steve? Oh no, he died. Oh no. Yes, indeed.
